data.source_title: II. Fundamental Elements Needed to Prevent Transmission of Infectious Agents in Healthcare Settings
data.locator: Section II.A.1.a, Scope of work for infection control professionals; Section II.B, surveillance
data.source_setting: Healthcare settings, including acute-care hospitals; CDC/HICPAC infection-control guidance.
data.source_period: Web chapter accessed 2026-10-10; chapter incorporates literature and guidance from multiple periods.
data.source_n: Not applicable for the listed workflow; historical staffing evidence in the chapter is excluded from scenario quantities.
value: monitor adherence and support prevention measures
participate in outbreak preparedness and investigation
communicate with staff, leadership and public-health partners
data.source_evidence_basis: CDC lists infection-control professional activities, including surveillance, adherence monitoring, outbreak preparedness, prevention measures, communications, and feedback; it describes surveillance as systematic collection, analysis, interpretation, and dissemination.
data.limitations: The chapter summarizes a broad and evolving scope, not a universal department chart or staffing ratio. Historical staffing ratios in the source should not be transferred as current standards or local capacity.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Represent infection prevention as a consult/review/notification dependency for isolation placement, exposure or cluster escalation, and policy feedback; actual response triggers and service availability require local protocols.
